message.content: Yes, the interface features a progress bar at the top of the quiz area, indicating that this is question 1 of 10. The question card is clearly visible and is distinguished by a prominent teal left border. The four answer options (A, B, C, and D) are displayed as individual buttons, each containing a circular bubble with its respective letter. A timer is also present in the upper right corner of the quiz section, currently showing 11:59 remaining. Overall, the layout is clean and well-organized for an interactive quiz experience.
